messages.author: dfab579a94fa5c7b
messages.subject: Combining families
parts:
Hi Karl,

What is the best way to combine different crosses? I have 3 intercross families and 1 backcross.
I have tried combining the crosses after running calc.genoprob, and then running scanone. I have also tried running the scans on each family separately then adding the LOD scores, but I get very different results with each of these methods.

thanks,
Melanie

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Combining families
parts:
I don't think there's a universal "best".

Adding LOD scores from separate analyses should be about the same as running them together with a cross x QTL interaction.

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Combining families
parts:
cross x QTL interaction would be to use addcovar=cross and intcovar=cross,
provided that cross is a matrix of indicators for the crosses, with one fewer columns than there are crosses.

I can’t tell what’s going on with the X chromosome without more information. Exactly what are the crosses, and what are their possible genotypes on the X chromosome.

karl
